cl_topology.principle: Caesar’s Legions fill and border are generated from the same perimeter geometry.
cl_topology.river_display_plan: HydroRIVERS selected for later hydrology rebuild; v0.11 intentionally does not replace the whole continent river layer before CL topology approval.

hydrology.primary_display: Natural Earth 1:50m base rivers/lake centerlines, filtered to North America and classified consistently by full named river rather than individual segment.
hydrology.fallback: bundled major + medium river layers only; dense minor fallback suppressed.
hydrology.visibility: major rivers always; medium rivers at regional zoom; minor rivers only at close zoom.
hydrology.continuity_policy: all segments sharing a normalized river name receive the same visual class so a river does not change visibility mid-course.

versioning_note: Globe/cartography refinements to the v0.10 update use patch versions. The preceding development builds labeled v0.11/v0.12/v0.13 correspond conceptually to v0.10.1/v0.10.2/v0.10.3.
topology_policy: Do not redraw approved routes. Where canon says a frontier follows a river/lake/coast/ridge/road, that approved route governs the political line and neighboring fill edge.
rendering_policy: All political borders render black. River-border overlays render above rivers and fully cover the river stroke where coincident. Country selection uses brighter selected fill, muted neighboring fills, and a thicker black perimeter overlay; geometry is unchanged from v0.10.4.
